mentions.name: graph insight
mentions.description: A semantic graph tool for exploring research papers that extracts keyphrases, builds a 3D graph, and lets users navigate from documents to topics to clusters. It has processed ~28k papers and mapped 100k+ topics, aiming to speed up literature review and reveal hidden links between research areas.
mentions.problem: Literature review is slow and research areas read as isolated PDFs rather than a connected landscape, making hidden links between papers hard to spot.
mentions.audience: Researchers and engineers reviewing research literature; the author also suggests it could apply to news/media streams.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on graph insight, a semantic graph tool for exploring research papers.
It extracts keyphrases, builds a 3D graph, and lets you navigate from documents > topics > clusters.
